items.title: Robots Don't Build Brands. People Do.
excerpts: The team began with a simple human observation: people protect their skin from UV exposure — why not their hair? They then combined AI with human creativity to explore consumer insights, develop concepts, land on the brand idea "Pantene Sunkiss Glow Spray for Strong Hair, Shinier than the Sun," create a package mock-up the same day and produce prototype advertising in a one-day shoot. The result: five times the assets, five times faster and at one-fifth the cost.

items.title: Seth Cohen on Accelerating AI Adoption for Lasting Business Impact
excerpts: P&G is creating the CPG company of the future, with AI playing a key role in accelerating its transformation. At HumanX 2026, a conference that gathers 6,500 AI leaders, builders and inventors, P&G’s CIO Seth Cohen took the stage to share how the company embeds AI across its operations to turn insight into impact and deliver sustained, strong business results.

Cohen highlighted how P&G teams identified an unmet consumer need for sun protection in hair care. Using AI, they were able to rapidly develop the Pantene Sunkiss Glow Spray, moving from insight to product concept, packaging, and communications in just days instead of weeks.
Our ability to integrate data into operations is critical to enable AI. I realize AI today gets all the headlines but AI without data is simply “A” – it’s artificial.
